# infrawrench_cost_report_anomaly_alert (Resource)

Anomaly alerts scoped to one `infrawrench_cost_report`: the report's filtered daily total (its filters and saved filter, per currency) is judged against its trailing 28 days after each cost collection, and a day that spikes is sent to this resource's own destinations.

It runs **beside** the organization's anomaly detection and `infrawrench_alert_routing`, not instead of them: routing rules neither redirect, swallow nor hold these alerts for quiet hours, because the report's owner chose these destinations for this scope. One per report; the resource is addressed, and imported, by the report's id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Page the platform team when the platform report's own scope spikes, at a
# lower bar than the organization-wide anomaly settings.
resource "infrawrench_cost_report_anomaly_alert" "platform" {
  cost_report_id  = infrawrench_cost_report.platform.id
  sigmas          = 2.5
  min_delta_cents = 5000

  destination {
    kind       = "slack"
    channel_id = infrawrench_slack_channel.platform_costs.id
  }

  destination {
    kind    = "email-address"
    address = "platform-finance@example.com"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cost_report_id` (String) The report whose scope is watched. Changing it replaces the alert: the alert is nested under the report, so there is nothing to move.

### Optional

- `destination` (Block List) Where a finding goes, in the `infrawrench_alert_routing` destination vocabulary (see that resource for each kind). At least one is required while `enabled`, at most 20. Each destination must belong to this organization: a connected Slack channel, a Teams webhook, a current member, an address the email policy allows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--destination))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`. A disabled alert keeps its settings and is not evaluated.
- `min_delta_cents` (Number) Least rise over the trailing mean before a day is reported, however many standard deviations it is, in cents of the spend's **own** currency (not converted: you state it for this report). 100–10000000; defaults to 1000.
- `sigmas` (Number) Standard deviations above the report's trailing 28-day mean that count as a spike, 1–10. Lower is more sensitive. Defaults to 3, the organization-wide default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned alert id. Import addresses the resource by `cost_report_id`, since a report has at most one alert.

<a id="nestedblock--destination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination`

Required:

- `kind` (String) One of `push`, `slack`, `msteams`, `on-call`, `github-issues`, `email-member`, `email-address`, `paging-provider`, `provider-on-call`.

Optional:

- `account_id` (String) For `paging-provider` and `provider-on-call`: a connected paging account's `id`.
- `address` (String) For `email-address`: a literal address, which must pass the organization's external-address policy.
- `channel_id` (String) For `slack`: the `id` of an `infrawrench_slack_channel`.
- `schedule_id` (String) For `on-call`: the `id` of an `infrawrench_on_call_schedule`.
- `source_id` (String) For `provider-on-call`: the provider's id for a schedule or escalation policy.
- `target_id` (String) For `paging-provider`: the provider's id for the target.
- `user_id` (String) For `email-member`: a member's `id` from the `infrawrench_members` data source.
- `webhook_id` (String) For `msteams`: the `id` of an `infrawrench_msteams_webhook`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A report has at most one anomaly alert, so the report's id addresses it.
terraform import infrawrench_cost_report_anomaly_alert.platform 7b8c9d0e-1f2a-3b4c-5d6e-7f8a9b0c1d2e
```
